verdict.rationale: Grok is itself the built-in assistant, and the docs show real task delegation. Grok Bot lets you hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer. Inside chat, Grok can act on connected tools: it can create Salesforce records, send Teams messages and manage Drive files, and it can orchestrate multi-agent research. One community report of weak agentic tool calling concerns Grok 4 in a third-party harness, so it does not contradict in-product delegation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Grok Bot delegation works and its limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegated in-product tasks succeeding.
